description: This file defines a parser class for JSON data, allowing it to be parsed and integrated into a larger debugging or data inspection tool.

classes.name: Kint_Parsers_Json
classes.description: A parser class designed to decode JSON strings into PHP data structures and integrate with the kint debugging utility.

methods.name: _parse
methods.description: An internal method that attempts to parse a variable as JSON if it is a string starting with '{' or '[', and if json_decode returns a non-null result.
